Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff357|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff41|r Health
|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6620|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6620|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons

Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might

You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

To you, flame is fuel.

1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

4.name: A Soul Ablaze

The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon

Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

12.name: Mountain Giant

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4697|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

|cffffff41|r Health
|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4683|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4650|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1009|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1298|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1419|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11257|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4683|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4650|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1009|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1298|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6606|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1419|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might

You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff252|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4683|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4683|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4650|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1009|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff90|r% and its damage done by |cffffff45|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff41|r Health
|cffffff40|r Magicka
|cffffff40|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4683|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6620|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:
Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff1|r minute.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:
Call down a battle standard for |cffffff15|r seconds, rallying you and group members inside the area, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff300|r and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%. You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

An ally near the standard can activate the Shackle synergy, dealing |cffffff11285|r Flame Damage to enemies in the area and immobilizing them for |cffffff5|r seconds.

Increase Health Recovery by |cffffff505|r.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

11.description:

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

1.name: Stampede
1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4661|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1011|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fire Keeper
2.description:
Throw out a purifying flame, filling a large area with warmth for |cffffff15|r seconds. This fire heals you and your allies at the target location for |cffffff1302|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. This healing increases by |cffffff50|r% if you are in the area.

Healed targets gain Minor Fortitude and Minor Heroism for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing Health Recovery by |cffffff15|r% and generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

3.name: Incinerate
3.description:
Activate an aura of flames which launches a wave of flames every |cffffff5|r seconds, dealing |cffffff6620|r Flame Damage directly to enemies inside.

Each hit has a |cffffff15|r% chance of applying Burning.

While slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Igneous Weapons
4.description:

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1423|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Equilibrium
5.description:

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

6.name: Standard of Might
6.description:

You gain an additional |cffffff15|r% damage done, |cffffff15|r% reduced damage taken, and |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage.

5.name: Burning Embers

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7106|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1065|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7106|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1065|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4459|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

2.name: Magma Fist

5.name: Burning Embers

Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4459|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5538|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5574|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7221|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff6990|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2196|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11372|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4394|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5721|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8510|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3495|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9885|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff6958|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1042|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

2.description:

2.name: Traumatic Burns

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:

7.description:

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.

7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4459|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7106|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1065|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff47|r Health
|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.
1.name: Brawler

2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.
2.name: Magma Fist

3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.
3.name: Flame Lash

4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.
4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire

5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7106|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1065|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.
5.name: Burning Embers

6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.
6.name: Magma Shell

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:

13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:

14.name: Wildfire Embers

3.name: Flame Lash

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.description:

5.name: Burning Embers

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.name: Inexorable Descent

1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina
8.name: The Storm Voice

9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.
9.name: Heart of Stone

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.
10.name: Landslide

11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.
11.name: Blessing at the Peak

12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.
12.name: Mountain Giant

13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
13.name: Inexorable Descent

14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4459|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
14.name: Wildfire Embers

1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5538|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5574|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.
1.name: Brawler

2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7221|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.
2.name: Magma Fist

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11372|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4394|r Health.
3.name: Flame Lash

4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5721|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8510|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.
4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire

5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3495|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9885|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff7171|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff1074|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.
5.name: Burning Embers

6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.
6.name: Magma Shell

To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.
1.name: Combustion

2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.
2.name: Traumatic Burns

3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.
3.name: Fan the Flames

4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.
4.name: A Soul Ablaze

5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Burnished Scales

6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.
6.name: World in Ruin

7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r
7.name: Elder Dragon

8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.
