5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff10167|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.

Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4621|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

15.description:
Increases your Spell Resistance by |cffffff726|r for each piece of Light Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff726|r.

16.name: Prodigy
16.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Critical rating by |cffffff219|r for each piece of Light Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff219|r.

17.name: Concentration
17.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Penetration by |cffffff939|r for each piece of Light Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff939|r

18.name: Medium Armor Bonuses
18.description:
Each piece of Medium Armor does the following:

Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff5|r%

Reduces the cost of Block by |cffffff3|r%

Reduces damage taken from Area of Effect attacks by |cffffff2|r% for |cffffff2|r seconds after you use Roll Dodge

Increases Movement Speed by |cffffff2|r% while immune to crowd control

19.name: Dexterity
19.description:
Increases your Critical Damage and Healing done rating by |cffffff2|r% for every piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.

20.name: Wind Walker
20.description:
Increases your Stamina Recovery by |cffffff4|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your abilities by |cffffff2|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.

21.name: Improved Sneak
21.description:
Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff7|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff7|r%.

Reduces the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff5|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff5|r%.

22.name: Agility
22.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Medium Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.

23.name: Athletics
23.description:
Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff3|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff3|r%.

Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.

24.name: Heavy Armor Bonuses
24.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Reduces damage taken from Martial attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the amount of damage blocked by |cffffff1|r%

Increases damage done with Bash by |cffffff30|r

Reduces your damage taken while immune to crowd control by |cffffff1|r%

25.name: Heavy Armor Penalties
25.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Increases damage taken from Magical attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff3|r%

Increases the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff10|r%

26.name: Resolve
26.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff343|r for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff1716|r.

27.name: Constitution
27.description:
Increases your Health Recovery by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff20|r%.

You restore |cffffff108|r Magicka and Stamina when you take damage for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds. 

Current bonus: |cffffff541|r.

28.name: Juggernaut
28.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.  

Current bonus: |cffffff10|r%.

29.name: Revitalize
29.description:
Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff20|r%

30.name: Rapid Mending
30.description:
Increases your healing received by |cffffff1|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff5|r%

31.name: Hand Brush
31.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of soil or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Generates: |c19D3FF1 Intuition|r
Maximum Intuition: |cFFFFFF4|r.

32.name: Augur
32.description:
Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. 

Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty.

Works on |cFFFFFFthe lowest six layers|r of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot.

|cFFFFFFUsing Augur does not consume a turn.|r

33.name: Trowel
33.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF3|r layers of dirt or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFCan safely trigger Fissures to create explosive chain reactions.|r

34.name: Keen Eye: Dig Sites
34.description: Antiquity Dig Sites will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

35.name: Excavator's Reserves
35.description: Further increases the amount of time you have available when excavating a dig site.

36.name: Heavy Shovel
36.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of dirt and rocks from up to a |cFFFFFF3x3|r area.

The shovel only affects a single contiguous height of dirt and rocks.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFHas a chance to consume no Intuition on use.|r

37.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests
37.description: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

38.name: Improved Hiding
38.description: Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff40|r%.

39.name: Light Fingers
39.description: Increases your chances of successfully Pickpocketing by |cffffff50|r%

40.name: Trafficker
40.description: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by |cffffff180|r%.

41.name: Locksmith
41.description: Improves your chances of forcing locks by |cffffff70|r%.

42.name: Kickback
42.description: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by |cffffff40|r%.

43.name: Scry
43.description:
Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control.

Consumes 1 turn.

44.name: Antiquarian Insight
44.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Ultimate difficulty.

45.name: Scrier's Patience
45.description: Grants you two additional turns of Scrying.

46.name: Coalescence
46.description:
Unites a hexagonal cluster of facets in the Antiquarian's Eye, converting the symbols to match that of the central facet.

New Effect: The ability's range increases by one facet, creating a snowflake-like pattern.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

47.name: Future Focus
47.description: Grants you two additional Magicka Charges for use in Scrying.

48.name: Dilation
48.description:
Claim all facets of the selected type that touch your area of control, as well as matching facets directly adjacent.

New Effect: Dilation now claims ALL contiguous facets of the same type.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

49.name: Farsight
49.description:
Claim a line of facets, stretching out from your area of control.

New Effect: Range increased from 4 facets to 6.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

50.name: Preemptive Power
50.description: Start each Scrying attempt with an additional row of facets already claimed.

51.name: Soul Summons
51.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.

52.name: Soul Shatter
52.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff3000|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.

53.name: Soul Lock
53.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.

54.name: Blade of Woe
54.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.

55.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice
55.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.

56.name: Padomaic Sprint
56.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff12|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.

57.name: Shadowy Supplier
57.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.

58.name: Shadow Rider
58.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.

59.name: Spectral Assassin
59.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.

60.name: Intimidating Presence
60.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

61.name: Slayer
61.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff3|r% for each Fighters Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

62.name: Banish the Wicked
62.description: You generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate whenever you kill an enemy.

63.name: Skilled Tracker
63.description: Your Fighters Guild abilities deal an additional |cffffff10|r% damage. This bonus doubles against player Vampires and Werewolves.

64.name: Bounty Hunter
64.description: Allows you to accept bounty quests from the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil.

65.name: Persuasive Will
65.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

66.name: Mage Adept
66.description: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

67.name: Everlasting Magic
67.description: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

68.name: Magicka Controller
68.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff2|r% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

69.name: Might of the Guild
69.description: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff150|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.

70.name: See the Unseen
70.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.

71.name: Clairvoyance
71.description: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

72.name: Spell Orb
72.description:
When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for |cffffff10|r seconds. When you reach |cffffff5|r spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing |cffffff3412|r Magic Damage.

This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.

73.name: Concentrated Barrier
73.description:
While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5750|r damage. 

This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend |cffffff10|r seconds not Bracing.

74.name: Deliberation
74.description: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by |cffffff30|r%.

75.name: Finders Keepers
75.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.

76.name: Swiftly Forgotten
76.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.

77.name: Haggling
77.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.

78.name: Clemency
78.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.

79.name: Timely Escape
79.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.

80.name: Veil of Shadows
80.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.

81.name: Undaunted Command
81.description:
Activating a synergy restores |cffffff4|r% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

Current Bonus: |cffffff1092|r Health, |cffffff1065|r Stamina, and |cffffff605|r Magicka.

82.name: Undaunted Mettle
82.description:
Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by |cffffff2|r% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff6|r%.

83.name: Continuous Attack
83.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

84.name: Reach
84.description:
Increases the range of long-range abilities by |cffffff5|r meters while near a keep or outpost.

Any ability with a range greater than |cffffff28|r meters is affected.

85.name: Combat Frenzy
85.description: You generate |cffffff20|r Ultimate when you kill an enemy player.

86.name: Magicka Aid
86.description:
Increases your Magicka Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for each Support ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

87.name: Combat Medic
87.description: Increases your healing done by |cffffff20|r% when you are near a Keep.

88.name: Battle Resurrection
88.description: Reduces the time it takes you to resurrect another player by |cffffff30|r% while you are in a PvP area.

89.name: Diplomat
89.description:
Increases your experience gain with the One Hand and Shield skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases your gold gained by |cffffff1|r%.

92.name: Red Diamond
92.description: Reduces the cost of all your abilities by |cffffff6|r%.

1.name: Combustion
1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.

2.name: Traumatic Burns
2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.

3.name: Fan the Flames
3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.

4.name: A Soul Ablaze
4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.

5.name: Burnished Scales
5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.

6.name: World in Ruin
6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon
7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff252|r

8.name: The Storm Voice
8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff47|r Health
|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina

9.name: Heart of Stone
9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.

10.name: Landslide
10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.

11.name: Blessing at the Peak
11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

12.name: Mountain Giant
12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.

13.name: Inexorable Descent
13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

14.name: Wildfire Embers
14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

12.trait: Increases weapon enchantment effect by |cffffff30|r% and reduces enchantment cooldown by |cFFFFFF50|r%.

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff5831|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff874|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:

Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

13.name: Inexorable Descent

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff5831|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff874|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times.

4.name: Resolute Defense

Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2733|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff2186|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff6162|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health.

An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4621|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

21.description:

22.name: Agility
22.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Medium Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.

23.name: Athletics
23.description:
Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff3|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff3|r%.

Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.

24.name: Heavy Armor Bonuses
24.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Reduces damage taken from Martial attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the amount of damage blocked by |cffffff1|r%

Increases damage done with Bash by |cffffff30|r

Reduces your damage taken while immune to crowd control by |cffffff1|r%

25.name: Heavy Armor Penalties
25.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Increases damage taken from Magical attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff3|r%

Increases the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff10|r%

26.name: Resolve
26.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff343|r for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff1716|r.

27.name: Constitution
27.description:
Increases your Health Recovery by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff20|r%.

You restore |cffffff108|r Magicka and Stamina when you take damage for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds. 

Current bonus: |cffffff541|r.

28.name: Juggernaut
28.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.  

Current bonus: |cffffff10|r%.

29.name: Revitalize
29.description:
Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff20|r%

30.name: Rapid Mending
30.description:
Increases your healing received by |cffffff1|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff5|r%

31.name: Hand Brush
31.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of soil or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Generates: |c19D3FF1 Intuition|r
Maximum Intuition: |cFFFFFF4|r.

32.name: Augur
32.description:
Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. 

Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty.

Works on |cFFFFFFthe lowest six layers|r of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot.

|cFFFFFFUsing Augur does not consume a turn.|r

33.name: Trowel
33.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF3|r layers of dirt or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFCan safely trigger Fissures to create explosive chain reactions.|r

34.name: Keen Eye: Dig Sites
34.description: Antiquity Dig Sites will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

35.name: Excavator's Reserves
35.description: Further increases the amount of time you have available when excavating a dig site.

36.name: Heavy Shovel
36.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of dirt and rocks from up to a |cFFFFFF3x3|r area.

The shovel only affects a single contiguous height of dirt and rocks.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFHas a chance to consume no Intuition on use.|r

37.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests
37.description: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

38.name: Improved Hiding
38.description: Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff40|r%.

39.name: Light Fingers
39.description: Increases your chances of successfully Pickpocketing by |cffffff50|r%

40.name: Trafficker
40.description: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by |cffffff180|r%.

41.name: Locksmith
41.description: Improves your chances of forcing locks by |cffffff70|r%.

42.name: Kickback
42.description: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by |cffffff40|r%.

43.name: Scry
43.description:
Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control.

Consumes 1 turn.

44.name: Antiquarian Insight
44.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Ultimate difficulty.

45.name: Scrier's Patience
45.description: Grants you two additional turns of Scrying.

46.name: Coalescence
46.description:
Unites a hexagonal cluster of facets in the Antiquarian's Eye, converting the symbols to match that of the central facet.

New Effect: The ability's range increases by one facet, creating a snowflake-like pattern.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

47.name: Future Focus
47.description: Grants you two additional Magicka Charges for use in Scrying.

48.name: Dilation
48.description:
Claim all facets of the selected type that touch your area of control, as well as matching facets directly adjacent.

New Effect: Dilation now claims ALL contiguous facets of the same type.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

49.name: Farsight
49.description:
Claim a line of facets, stretching out from your area of control.

New Effect: Range increased from 4 facets to 6.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

50.name: Preemptive Power
50.description: Start each Scrying attempt with an additional row of facets already claimed.

51.name: Soul Summons
51.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.

52.name: Soul Shatter
52.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff3000|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.

53.name: Soul Lock
53.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.

54.name: Blade of Woe
54.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.

55.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice
55.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.

56.name: Padomaic Sprint
56.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff12|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.

57.name: Shadowy Supplier
57.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.

58.name: Shadow Rider
58.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.

59.name: Spectral Assassin
59.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.

60.name: Intimidating Presence
60.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

61.name: Slayer
61.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff3|r% for each Fighters Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

62.name: Banish the Wicked
62.description: You generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate whenever you kill an enemy.

63.name: Skilled Tracker
63.description: Your Fighters Guild abilities deal an additional |cffffff10|r% damage. This bonus doubles against player Vampires and Werewolves.

64.name: Bounty Hunter
64.description: Allows you to accept bounty quests from the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil.

65.name: Persuasive Will
65.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

66.name: Mage Adept
66.description: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

67.name: Everlasting Magic
67.description: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

68.name: Magicka Controller
68.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff2|r% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

69.name: Might of the Guild
69.description: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff150|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.

70.name: See the Unseen
70.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.

71.name: Clairvoyance
71.description: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

72.name: Spell Orb
72.description:
When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for |cffffff10|r seconds. When you reach |cffffff5|r spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing |cffffff3412|r Magic Damage.

This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.

73.name: Concentrated Barrier
73.description:
While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5750|r damage. 

This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend |cffffff10|r seconds not Bracing.

74.name: Deliberation
74.description: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by |cffffff30|r%.

75.name: Finders Keepers
75.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.

76.name: Swiftly Forgotten
76.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.

77.name: Haggling
77.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.

78.name: Clemency
78.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.

79.name: Timely Escape
79.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.

80.name: Veil of Shadows
80.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.

81.name: Undaunted Command
81.description:
Activating a synergy restores |cffffff4|r% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

Current Bonus: |cffffff1092|r Health, |cffffff1065|r Stamina, and |cffffff605|r Magicka.

82.name: Undaunted Mettle
82.description:
Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by |cffffff2|r% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff6|r%.

83.name: Continuous Attack
83.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

84.name: Reach
84.description:
Increases the range of long-range abilities by |cffffff5|r meters while near a keep or outpost.

Any ability with a range greater than |cffffff28|r meters is affected.

85.name: Combat Frenzy
85.description: You generate |cffffff20|r Ultimate when you kill an enemy player.

86.name: Magicka Aid
86.description:
Increases your Magicka Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for each Support ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

87.name: Combat Medic
87.description: Increases your healing done by |cffffff20|r% when you are near a Keep.

88.name: Battle Resurrection
88.description: Reduces the time it takes you to resurrect another player by |cffffff30|r% while you are in a PvP area.

89.name: Diplomat
89.description:
Increases your experience gain with the One Hand and Shield skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases your gold gained by |cffffff1|r%.

92.name: Red Diamond
92.description: Reduces the cost of all your abilities by |cffffff6|r%.

1.name: Combustion
1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.

2.name: Traumatic Burns
2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.

3.name: Fan the Flames
3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.

4.name: A Soul Ablaze
4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.

5.name: Burnished Scales
5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.

6.name: World in Ruin
6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon
7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff28|r

8.name: The Storm Voice
8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff47|r Health
|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina

9.name: Heart of Stone
9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.

10.name: Landslide
10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.

11.name: Blessing at the Peak
11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

12.name: Mountain Giant
12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.

13.name: Inexorable Descent
13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

14.name: Wildfire Embers
14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff5831|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff874|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

Reduces the Stamina cost of your abilities by |cffffff2|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.

21.name: Improved Sneak
21.description:
Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff7|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff7|r%.

Reduces the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff5|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff5|r%.

22.name: Agility
22.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Medium Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.

23.name: Athletics
23.description:
Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff3|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff3|r%.

Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.

24.name: Heavy Armor Bonuses
24.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Reduces damage taken from Martial attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the amount of damage blocked by |cffffff1|r%

Increases damage done with Bash by |cffffff30|r

Reduces your damage taken while immune to crowd control by |cffffff1|r%

25.name: Heavy Armor Penalties
25.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Increases damage taken from Magical attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff3|r%

Increases the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff10|r%

26.name: Resolve
26.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff343|r for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff1716|r.

27.name: Constitution
27.description:
Increases your Health Recovery by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff20|r%.

You restore |cffffff108|r Magicka and Stamina when you take damage for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds. 

Current bonus: |cffffff541|r.

28.name: Juggernaut
28.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.  

Current bonus: |cffffff10|r%.

29.name: Revitalize
29.description:
Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff20|r%

30.name: Rapid Mending
30.description:
Increases your healing received by |cffffff1|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff5|r%

31.name: Hand Brush
31.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of soil or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Generates: |c19D3FF1 Intuition|r
Maximum Intuition: |cFFFFFF4|r.

32.name: Augur
32.description:
Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. 

Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty.

Works on |cFFFFFFthe lowest six layers|r of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot.

|cFFFFFFUsing Augur does not consume a turn.|r

33.name: Trowel
33.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF3|r layers of dirt or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFCan safely trigger Fissures to create explosive chain reactions.|r

34.name: Keen Eye: Dig Sites
34.description: Antiquity Dig Sites will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

35.name: Excavator's Reserves
35.description: Further increases the amount of time you have available when excavating a dig site.

36.name: Heavy Shovel
36.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of dirt and rocks from up to a |cFFFFFF3x3|r area.

The shovel only affects a single contiguous height of dirt and rocks.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFHas a chance to consume no Intuition on use.|r

37.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests
37.description: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

38.name: Improved Hiding
38.description: Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff40|r%.

39.name: Light Fingers
39.description: Increases your chances of successfully Pickpocketing by |cffffff50|r%

40.name: Trafficker
40.description: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by |cffffff180|r%.

41.name: Locksmith
41.description: Improves your chances of forcing locks by |cffffff70|r%.

42.name: Kickback
42.description: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by |cffffff40|r%.

43.name: Scry
43.description:
Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control.

Consumes 1 turn.

44.name: Antiquarian Insight
44.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Ultimate difficulty.

45.name: Scrier's Patience
45.description: Grants you two additional turns of Scrying.

46.name: Coalescence
46.description:
Unites a hexagonal cluster of facets in the Antiquarian's Eye, converting the symbols to match that of the central facet.

New Effect: The ability's range increases by one facet, creating a snowflake-like pattern.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

47.name: Future Focus
47.description: Grants you two additional Magicka Charges for use in Scrying.

48.name: Dilation
48.description:
Claim all facets of the selected type that touch your area of control, as well as matching facets directly adjacent.

New Effect: Dilation now claims ALL contiguous facets of the same type.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

49.name: Farsight
49.description:
Claim a line of facets, stretching out from your area of control.

New Effect: Range increased from 4 facets to 6.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

50.name: Preemptive Power
50.description: Start each Scrying attempt with an additional row of facets already claimed.

51.name: Soul Summons
51.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.

52.name: Soul Shatter
52.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff3000|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.

53.name: Soul Lock
53.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.

54.name: Blade of Woe
54.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.

55.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice
55.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.

56.name: Padomaic Sprint
56.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff12|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.

57.name: Shadowy Supplier
57.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.

58.name: Shadow Rider
58.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.

59.name: Spectral Assassin
59.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.

60.name: Intimidating Presence
60.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

61.name: Slayer
61.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff3|r% for each Fighters Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

62.name: Banish the Wicked
62.description: You generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate whenever you kill an enemy.

63.name: Skilled Tracker
63.description: Your Fighters Guild abilities deal an additional |cffffff10|r% damage. This bonus doubles against player Vampires and Werewolves.

64.name: Bounty Hunter
64.description: Allows you to accept bounty quests from the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil.

65.name: Persuasive Will
65.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

66.name: Mage Adept
66.description: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

67.name: Everlasting Magic
67.description: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

68.name: Magicka Controller
68.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff2|r% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

69.name: Might of the Guild
69.description: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff150|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.

70.name: See the Unseen
70.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.

71.name: Clairvoyance
71.description: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

72.name: Spell Orb
72.description:
When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for |cffffff10|r seconds. When you reach |cffffff5|r spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing |cffffff3412|r Magic Damage.

This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.

73.name: Concentrated Barrier
73.description:
While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5750|r damage. 

This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend |cffffff10|r seconds not Bracing.

74.name: Deliberation
74.description: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by |cffffff30|r%.

75.name: Finders Keepers
75.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.

76.name: Swiftly Forgotten
76.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.

77.name: Haggling
77.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.

78.name: Clemency
78.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.

79.name: Timely Escape
79.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.

80.name: Veil of Shadows
80.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.

81.name: Undaunted Command
81.description:
Activating a synergy restores |cffffff4|r% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

Current Bonus: |cffffff1092|r Health, |cffffff1065|r Stamina, and |cffffff605|r Magicka.

82.name: Undaunted Mettle
82.description:
Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by |cffffff2|r% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff6|r%.

83.name: Continuous Attack
83.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

84.name: Reach
84.description:
Increases the range of long-range abilities by |cffffff5|r meters while near a keep or outpost.

Any ability with a range greater than |cffffff28|r meters is affected.

85.name: Combat Frenzy
85.description: You generate |cffffff20|r Ultimate when you kill an enemy player.

86.name: Magicka Aid
86.description:
Increases your Magicka Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for each Support ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

87.name: Combat Medic
87.description: Increases your healing done by |cffffff20|r% when you are near a Keep.

88.name: Battle Resurrection
88.description: Reduces the time it takes you to resurrect another player by |cffffff30|r% while you are in a PvP area.

89.name: Diplomat
89.description:
Increases your experience gain with the One Hand and Shield skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases your gold gained by |cffffff1|r%.

92.name: Red Diamond
92.description: Reduces the cost of all your abilities by |cffffff6|r%.

1.name: Combustion
1.description:
To you, flame is fuel. 

When you apply Burning to an enemy, you restore |cffffff225|r Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every |cffffff1|r second.

2.name: Traumatic Burns
2.description:
Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.

Dealing direct damage with an Ardent Flame ability causes the target to take |cffffff5|r% increased Flame Damage and reduces their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.

3.name: Fan the Flames
3.description:
Tend to your garden of flame, that it may flourish.

Increases your chances of applying the Burning status effect by |cffffff100|r% and its damage done by |cffffff50|r%. These values are influenced by the number of Dragonknight abilities slotted.

4.name: A Soul Ablaze
4.description:
The will to survive burns bright in your chest.

Increases your Healing Taken by |cffffff8|r%.

5.name: Burnished Scales
5.description:
A Dragon's scales will turn aside arrow, fire, and blade.

Increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff10|r%.

6.name: World in Ruin
6.description:
Dragons leave naught but ash and ruin in their wake.

Increases your damage done with area and over time attacks by |cffffff7|r%.

7.name: Elder Dragon
7.description:
The eldest Dragons are forces of nature. As are you.

Activating a Draconic Power ability grants you and group members Minor Brutality for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

Increases your Health Recovery by up to |cffffff700|r, based on your missing Health.
Current amount: |cffffff0|r

8.name: The Storm Voice
8.description:
The syllables of that ancient tongue live in the mouth of every Dragonknight.

When you cast an Ultimate ability, you restore |cffffff16|r Health, |cffffff16|r Magicka, and |cffffff16|r Stamina for every Ultimate spent. Each Dragonknight ability slotted increases this value by |cffffff6|r.

Current amount:
|cffffff47|r Health
|cffffff46|r Magicka
|cffffff46|r Stamina

9.name: Heart of Stone
9.description:
Rock and stone shield your heart, turning aside sharp blades and barbed words.

Increases your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.

10.name: Landslide
10.description:
Given time, the smallest rock on the mountain can cascade into pure devastation.

Whenever you deal damage you gain a stack of Landslide which increases your damage done by |cffffff1|r% per stack, up to |cffffff12|r times. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds.

Every |cffffff6|r seconds you fail to generate a stack, you instead lose a stack.

11.name: Blessing at the Peak
11.description:
Where earth meets sky is a wellspring of power you can tap at will.

When you cast or deal damage with an Earthen Heart ability in combat you generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

12.name: Mountain Giant
12.description:
The strength of mountains fuels your mightiest blows.

Dealing damage with a fully-charged Heavy Attack also applies Off Balance to the target and restores |cffffff1430|r Stamina. The Stamina restore can occur once every |cffffff0.5|r seconds.

13.name: Inexorable Descent
13.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

14.name: Wildfire Embers
14.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff5588|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5625|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Magma Fist
2.description:
Draw forth magma from below to hurl at an enemy, dealing |cffffff7284|r Flame Damage while applying a stack of Heat Shock, which increases the enemy's damage taken by |cffffff66|r for |cffffff7|r seconds per stack, up to |cffffff3|r times.

Hitting an enemy at max stacks of Heat Shock with this ability increases the damage done of the next cast of this ability within |cffffff6|r seconds by |cffffff66|r%, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds.

3.name: Flame Lash
3.description:
Lash an enemy with flame, dealing |cffffff7051|r Flame Damage and healing for |cffffff2217|r Health.

Hitting an Off Balance enemy grants |cffffff5|r stacks of Power Lash for |cffffff20|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff20|r seconds. After activating, you gain |cffffff3|r% damage done to monsters for |cffffff45|r seconds.

Activating again consumes a stack to deal |cffffff11473|r Flame Damage to your target and all nearby enemies and heals for |cffffff4435|r Health.

4.name: Disintegrating Dragonfire
4.description:
Exhale a blast of draconic fire in front of you, dealing |cffffff5771|r Flame Damage, applying the Burning status effect, and an additional |cffffff8580|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds to enemies in your path.

The initial hit liquifies the armor of your enemies, applying Major Breach to enemies for the duration, reducing Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r.

5.name: Burning Embers
5.description:
Slash your foe with a fiery claw, dealing |cffffff3526|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff9975|r Flame Damage over |cffffff10|r seconds.

You heal for |cffffff5831|r Health from the initial hit and |cffffff874|r Health each subsequent tick, scaling off your Max Health.

The initial hit always applies the Burning status effect.

6.name: Magma Shell
6.description:
Ignite the molten lava in your veins, limiting incoming damage to |cffffff3|r% of your Max Health for |cffffff15|r seconds.

When activated, nearby allies gain a damage shield for |cffffff153|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff10|r seconds.

While active, you cannot generate Ultimate.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4501|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff6162|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.

Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4621|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

Fire cares not for love, or coin, or creed. It consumes.
